fr_depecher_verb.why: He holds the mirror for se dépêcher.

fr_accompagner_verb.hook: A red-beret mime walks with a dog that carries a lunch basket (ah-kohn-pah-NYAY).

fr_avancer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime stands by a white van moving through three sheep (ah-vahn-SAY).

fr_poursuivre_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime runs with a collie chasing a red ball (pohr-SWEEVR).

fr_parvenir_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime reaches a golf ball toward the hole (pahr-vuh-NEER).

fr_importer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime opens a crate of bananas and a monkey climbs out (an-por-TAY).

fr_traverser_verb.hook: A red-beret mime holds a blank round sign while ducks cross (trah-vehr-SAY).

fr_croiser_verb.hook: A red-beret mime waves at two toy boats crossing in a basin (krwah-ZAY).

fr_penetrer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime and a mole come in through a window with a tray (pay-nay-TRAY).

fr_voyager_verb.hook: A red-beret mime walks beside a tortoise with a suitcase on a skateboard (vwah-yah-ZHAY).

fr_arriver_verb.hook: A red-beret mime cheers a racing pigeon landing on a post (ah-ree-VAY).

fr_suivre_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime follows a line of ducklings (SWEEVR).

fr_monter_verb.hook: A striped mime in a broad brown hat rides a horse up the bank (mohn-TAY).

fr_entrer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime steps in with a cat sitting on a silver tray (ahn-TRAY).

fr_animer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime works a wooden horse puppet on strings (ah-nee-MAY).

fr_conduire_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime drives a small cream car with a deer in the back (kohn-DWEER).

fr_marcher_verb.hook: A red-beret mime walks beside a tall gray heron (mahr-SHAY).

fr_promener_verb.hook: A red-beret mime holds a hand mirror beside a pony in a straw bonnet, because se promener is pronominal (prom-NAY).
ex: Nous nous promenons sous les arbres.
We go for a walk under the trees.

fr_approcher_verb.hook: A red-beret mime kneels as a kitten approaches a sleeping cat (ah-proh-SHAY).

fr_briser_verb.hook: A red-beret mime holds a hand mirror as the window shatters, because se briser is pronominal (bree-ZAY).

fr_bouger_verb.hook: A red-beret mime jumps and a wooden chair slides aside (boo-ZHAY).

fr_deplacer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime holds a hand mirror and pushes a piano on wheels, because se déplacer is pronominal (day-plah-SAY).
ex: Nous nous déplaçons avec le piano.
We move along with the piano.

fr_venir_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime carries a shiny wooden table and beckons (vuh-NEER).

fr_descendre_verb.hook: A gold-beret mime watches a black-and-white cat on a ladder (day-SAHNDR).

fr_refermer_verb.hook: A red-beret mime holds a hand mirror and pushes the door shut again, because se refermer is pronominal (ruh-fehr-MAY).
